summary: TD SYNNEX filed an 8-K reporting an Eighth Omnibus Amendment to its trade receivables securitization program, extending the maturity date to September 25, 2028 and raising aggregate lender commitments to $3.0 billion. The company's SIT Funding LLC subsidiary is borrower and TD SYNNEX is servicer/originator parent, with The Toronto-Dominion Bank as administrative agent. Program fees were reset to 0.725% for commercial-paper-funded advances and 0.825% otherwise, plus an upfront lender fee. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no equity, ownership, deal, or recommendation items arise.
